pr_title: GameEngine: plan native 2D gameplay and authoring
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds ADR 0127 proposing a native 2D architecture covering shared Transform ownership, stable sprite/tile identities, batched sprite rendering, Camera2D, sprite animation, chunked Tile Maps, isolated 2D physics, CharacterController2D, and an authoring-first Editor workflow.

The plan preserves existing domain/crate boundaries, routes persisted edits through shared authoring services for Editor/CLI/MCP parity, and requires a first-party 2D proving project plus visual/performance validation when implemented.
